Politics · India

PM Modi highlights climate inequality, defends India's emissions record

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that India's per capita carbon emissions are less than half of the global average and approximately six times lower than those of developed nations. He argued that placing the blame for carbon emissions on developing countries like India is incorrect. Modi also highlighted India's significant progress in environmental protection and clean energy initiatives. He emphasized the disparity in per capita emissions between developed and developing nations, asserting that the former emit substantially more.
